title: Uniform first-order upper bound for the area-formula Jacobian of I + tB on n-planes (parent steps 3–4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, A ≥ 0 and ε > 0. There is δ > 0 such that for every real t with |t| < δ, every linear subspace K ⊆ ℝ^P with dim K = n and every continuous linear B : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with ‖B‖ ≤ A: √det(((I + tB)∘ι_K)* ∘ ((I + tB)∘ι_K)) ≤ 1 + t·trace(P_K ∘ B) + ε|t|, where ι_K = K.subtypeL : K → ℝ^P is the inclusion, * is the Hilbert adjoint (K with the induced inner product), det is the determinant of the resulting endomorphism of K (ContinuousLinearMap.det), P_K = K.starProjection and √ is Real.sqrt.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ → ∀ (K : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (B : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ K = n → ‖B‖ ≤ A → Real.sqrt ((((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • B).comp K.subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • B).comp K.subtypeL)).det) ≤ 1 + t * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (K.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ B.toLinearMap) + ε * |t|
